title: ENV RESET reaches AMP
author: MrScruff (rytm-mods); elemod port: Iced-Cream
description: SOUND SETTINGS ENV RESET can be set to AMP and AMP+FILT: with the amp bit set the amp envelope restarts from silence on every trig, so AMP ATK is heard on every hit (a retrig on a sounding voice can click). Port of rytm-mods 0015-env-reset-amp.
